items.html: *Indeed, as for those kings, the upper Emanator wished to create them at first in that manner, so that they would include the discernment of holiness — except that it is judgments and Gevurot, and mingled in them are the dregs and the shells. And with complete intention He created them so, in order that there be reward and punishment in the world, to exact payment from the wicked and to give a good reward to the righteous; and this is not the place to elaborate on it. Indeed, with complete intention He created them so, in order to annul them and put them to death, so that holy sparks would be clarified from them and would rise upward, while the shells mingled in them would remain below, in the secret of the dross of gold and the lees of wine.
